about: Grades against the papers (ASSISTANT grades). Run: c6 + retrieval R2 + p7 + v4.7c, 6 questions, 2026-11-14 (R2_p7_v47_c6/). 12 requests, 23,538 tokens (cap 30,000).

q14.why: AIAYN half correct and from the right passage: 'Sentences were encoded using byte-pair encoding, which has a shared source-target vocabulary of about 37000 tokens [AIAYN:5.1:c025]' (omits the 32000 word-piece vocabulary for English-French). H-Net half off-target: describes SpaceByte, a baseline that chunks on spaces [HNET:3:c041], not H-Net's learned byte-level dynamic chunking. Cause: the expanded query is also used for the H-Net slot, which drops HNET:abstract:c001 and protects HNET:3:c041.

q15.why: trained for as little as twelve hours on eight P100 GPUs (AIAYN:1:c003); Moshi on H100 (MOSHI:4.4:c062)

q04.why: context identical to E25 (where it was correct); the redraft added a false absence ('frame rate not stated'): sampling variance, not a retrieval change
